name: Candidate Core & Portal
purpose: Create the candidate identity, smart intake, profile review, portal read model, communication centre, support, finance view, and success-loop foundation.
candidate_laws: The candidate must not retype details already available in CVs and documents.
Smart forms must prefill from document-backed field sources.
Unknown or low-confidence fields must be asked clearly.
Candidate confirms extracted data before it becomes trusted profile data.
Sensitive profile corrections require operator approval.
No fake qualifications, references, certificates, skills, results, or experience.
Every profile field must be source-traceable when extracted from documents.
Candidate status must be visible without exposing internal worker complexity.
AI may suggest; it must not govern official status, payments, refunds, fraud, privacy, or hard blockers.
